description: Wait on higher.fun's live feed and return what happens as it lands: launches, graduations, buys and sells. Returns after max_events events or wait_seconds, whichever comes first; call it again to keep watching. For alerts such as 'tell me when this coin graduates', 'watch for buys over 1 SOL' or 'what launches next'. With mints, each trade includes the trader's wallet and token amount.

min_sol.description: Only buys and sells of at least this much SOL

mints.description: Only these coins' trades and graduations. Launches are new coins, so they're never filtered out.

items.description: The coin's mint address (base58). higher.fun mints usually end in 'high'.

name: watch_market
title: Watch the market live
